results.editorial_judgment: No teaching edit is warranted. The wording stays deliberately product-agnostic and does not promise one memory behavior, account entitlement or cross-chat guarantee.

overall_editorial_judgment: The unchanged exact Concepts 101 bytes remain properly qualified for this local candidate. This maker recheck is not an independent accuracy judgment or release-time public verification.
